content.title: Rockies Opening Day Party! - McGregor Square
content.text: Family Food & Dining Free Event Nightlife Sports & Recreation Friday, Apr 03, 2026 9:00 AM - 11:00 PM About this event Kick Off the 2026 Colorado Rockies Season at Denver’s Premier Game Day Destination Celebrate Opening Day right across the street from Coors Field at McGregor Square. There’s no better place in the city to feel the energy of Rockies Opening Day. Catch all the pre-game action on our 66-foot Big Screen before heading into the stadium. Don’t have tickets? Stay and watch the game in the Square alongside fellow fans. Drink specials begin at 9 AM, and a live DJ set from Denver’s own Daytona and Tati Nova will keep the energy high throughout the day starting at 10:30 AM. This is a FREE event. No ticket required! Valid ID required for alcoholic beverage purchases. Getting Here McGregor Square is conveniently located between Coors Field and Denver Union Station. Ride share or public transportation is strongly recommended. Guests taking RTD Light Rail are just a 2-block walk from Denver Union Station. Parking and valet are available between 19th and 20th on Wazee Street on a first-come, first-served basis.
